Boosting ESP32-C3 SuperMini WiFi: A Simple and Effective Antenna Mod

The ESP32-C3 SuperMini modules are incredibly affordable, costing around €2, and are equipped with a compact SMD antenna. However, this tiny antenna significantly limits the usable WiFi range due to its design. To address this issue with minimal effort, I implemented a simple antenna modification that drastically improved performance.

The Antenna Modification

This modification involves adding a 31 mm length of 1.0 mm silver-plated wire, configured as a quarter-wavelength (λ/4) antenna.
The bottom section of the wire is bent into a horizontal loop (approximately 16 mm of the wire length, forming a loop with a diameter of about 8 mm), while the remaining 15 mm section is angled vertically upwards.

I wrapped the circular loop around the shaft of a 5 mm drill and then widened the ends of the loop so that they touch the terminals of the SMD antenna. The SMD antenna effectively completes the wire loop—mechanically at a quarter of its circumference, but electrically as a λ/4 element in parallel with a λ/8 wire.

Solder the new antenna directly to both ends of the original SMD antenna on the ESP32 module. Specifically, solder to the 50 Ohm antenna pin (the left end of the original antenna) and to the other “hot” end of the original antenna. This effectively bypasses the original PCB antenna. Ensuring two good solder joints at both ends of the PCB antenna is crucial. Pay close attention to the position of the wire that goes up from the loop. The old aerial has been left in place as it becomes electrically ineffective in this configuration.

EDIT: Meanwhile, some adaptations of my antenna design have been published in blog posts and YouTube videos. However, some of these adaptations struggle with the TOTAL 31mm length of the antenna wire, leading to suggestions to elongate the vertical section to make the complete antenna a 5/8 lambda radiator. This isn’t very wise if you want the antenna to radiate omnidirectionally and preserve the acceptable mechanical dimensions.

Testing with the WiFi Logger Program

To evaluate the effectiveness of this modification, I used my custom WiFi logger program written for ANNEX32 BASIC. The program compares the signal strength (RSSI) of two ESP32 modules: one unmodified and one with the new antenna.

The live signal data was displayed in real-time on a tablet browser.

Both modules were mounted side by side on a portable power bank to ensure identical testing conditions while moving around various locations near an access point (AP).

Results

The signal strength curves recorded with the WiFi Logger program consistently demonstrated a clear superiority of the modified module over the original. Under the testing conditions, where both modules were mounted side-by-side on a power bank and moved around various locations near an access point (AP), the modified antenna consistently provided higher signal levels.

On average, the improvement in signal strength was at least approximately 6dB. In many cases, particularly at the edges of the WiFi signal range or in environments with more interference, the improvement even exceeded 10dB. This difference in signal strength had a significant impact on the stability of the connection. The modified module maintained a stable connection while the unmodified module was more prone to disconnections or performance degradation.

To illustrate the results:

  • In close proximity to the Access Point: The improvement was often 6 dB to 8 dB, resulting in a more stable and less fluctuating connection.
  • At a greater distance from the Access Point: The improvement often reached 10 dB or more, making the difference between a usable and unusable connection. The modified module could receive and send data, while the unmodified module could not establish a connection or suffered from extremely slow data transfer.
  • In environments with obstacles (e.g., walls): The modified antenna showed better penetration and provided a more stable connection compared to the unmodified module, which struggled to maintain the signal.

These improvements led to a significantly extended WiFi range. Theoretically, every 6 dB increase in signal strength corresponds to a doubling of the range. In practice, this means that the modified ESP32-C3 SuperMini module was able to establish a reliable WiFi connection in areas where the unmodified module had no or only a very unstable connection.

Observations

The original SMD antenna CrossAir CA-C03 placed at the ESP32-C3 SuperMini module, due to its small size, high dielectrical ceramic material, and the compact antenna geometry, is inherently less efficient at radiating and receiving RF energy than an in-air-standing antenna wire . Just because it is designed as a very compact quarter-wave antenna, on the other hand this results in a limited bandwidth and a more omnidirectional radiation pattern.

But in particular, the antenna was not positioned at the location on the PCB explicitly recommended by the manufacturer in the datasheet. Instead, the SMD antenna is mounted too close to the ground plane and other components. This positioning shields the RF energy rather than allowing for effective radiation.


I experimented with the new antenna made of a 0.8 mm ordinary switching wire and even removed SMD antenna from the board. But it actually works about 2dB better with the 1 mm silver plated wire and the untouched SMD antenna.

Caveats of a *Very* Compact Antenna Design

The <Datasheet> of the SMD antenna CA-C03 by Cross Air requires:
• PCB edge positioning,
• sufficient clearance around it,
• a 3.8 mm × 0.5 mm stripline,
• a 3 nH inductance “Shunt1”

The actual ESP32-C3 SuperMini‘s PCB design lacks several key features, most notably adequate free space around the antenna and an orthogonally radiating stripline, which also affects the antenna’s resonance frequency. These limitations result in misalignment, partially reflected RF energy and reduced RF efficiency.

An experimental, freer-standing mounting of the SMD antenna, more in line with the datasheet specifications, has already demonstrated an approximate 4 dB improvement in gain.

However, this could not overcome the fundamental limitations of this very compact SMD antenna compared to the simple quarter-wave wire antenna described as a modification here.

The latter angled wire antenna benefits from its electrically non-shortened geometry and a more unobstructed and more effective omnidirectional radiation, achieving sure gains of 6–10 dB compared to the original SMD antenna.


In contrast, the new, non-shortened and freestanding quarter-wave antenna can produce an undampened and more consistent field. This is likely due to the combination of now unshielded horizontal and vertical elements, which helps minimize null points in the omnidirectional radiation pattern and enhances signal coverage. The loop at the bottom of the antenna creates a horizontal radiation pattern without nulls, while the orthogonally angled element optimizes the vertically polarized component of the signal.


All these factors in the unmodified module appear to result in a poor standing wave ratio (SWR) at its RF output. This means that a significant portion of the RF energy is reflected back from the antenna into the ESP32 and thus can’t be radiated. As an additional consequence, the final TX stage heats up, potentially reducing the actual RF output power and thereby again reducing the transmission range. Under unfavorable conditions, the ESP32 may still receive a strong enough Wi-Fi signal, but the access point might receive a weaker or even insufficient signal from the ESP32.
The result is a significantly reduced Wi-Fi operation range of the unmodified module.

Interestingly, removing the actually obsolete original PCB antenna had no obvious effect and was therefore unnecessary. This suggests that the low-impedance lower part of the new antenna completely outperformed the PCB antenna, allowing the new, more prominent wire to take over and radiate the RF signal much more effectively. However, it is important to note that the correct placement and orientation of the angled end of the wire, along with its total length and diameter, are crucial for optimal performance.

Conclusion

The antenna modification presented offers a compelling and cost-effective method for significantly enhancing the WiFi performance of ESP32-C3 SuperMini modules. By combining the stock PCB antenna with a carefully crafted quarter-wavelength wire antenna, users can experience substantial improvements in signal strength, stability, and range. The observed gains of 6dB to over 10dB translate to more reliable connectivity, particularly in environments with weak signals or obstructions. This modification not only extends the usable range of the ESP32-C3 but also unlocks its potential for applications requiring robust and consistent wireless communication. While the modification requires basic soldering skills, the resulting performance boost makes it a worthwhile endeavor for hobbyists, makers, and developers seeking to maximize the capabilities of these inexpensive modules

The dilemma of choice

There are many slightly different ESP32-C3 SuperMini boards in the shops on the web. Here are some of these boards arranged for comparison regarding the antenna section.

Most of them still lack a good antenna design and do not adhere to the antenna’s datasheet guidelines.

Boards with an IPEX socket for an external antenna require soldering a jumper to activate the socket—and even then, the SMD antenna must be removed.

A greater distance between the SMD antenna,
the ESP chip, and other components could be an indicator of a better design, but it is not necessarily a guarantee.

All of these boards still exhibit very modest WiFi range, 
and the additional 31mm wire antenna continues to make a significant improvement.

blocks.html_en: Boosting ESP32-C3 SuperMini WiFi: A Simple and Effective Antenna Mod

sentences.en: Boosting ESP32-C3 SuperMini WiFi: A Simple and Effective Antenna Mod
sentences.zh: 增强 ESP32-C3 SuperMini WiFi：简单有效的天线模块

blocks.html_en: The ESP32-C3 SuperMini modules are incredibly affordable, costing around €2, and are equipped with a compact SMD antenna. However, this tiny antenna significantly limits the usable WiFi range due to its design. To address this issue with minimal effort, I implemented a simple antenna modification that drastically improved performance.

sentences.en: The ESP32-C3 SuperMini modules are incredibly affordable, costing around €2, and are equipped with a compact SMD antenna.
sentences.zh: ESP32-C3 SuperMini 模块价格极其实惠，价格约为 2 欧元，并配备紧凑型 SMD 天线。

sentences.en: However, this tiny antenna significantly limits the usable WiFi range due to its design.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于其设计，这种微型天线极大地限制了可用的 WiFi 范围。

sentences.en: To address this issue with minimal effort, I implemented a simple antenna modification that drastically improved performance.
sentences.zh: 为了以最小的努力解决这个问题，我实施了一个简单的天线修改，极大地提高了性能。

blocks.html_en: The Antenna Modification

sentences.en: The Antenna Modification
sentences.zh: 天线修改

blocks.html_en:
This modification involves adding a 31 mm length of 1.0 mm silver-plated wire, configured as a quarter-wavelength (λ/4) antenna.
The bottom section of the wire is bent into a horizontal loop (approximately 16 mm of the wire length, forming a loop with a diameter of about 8 mm), while the remaining 15 mm section is angled vertically upwards.

sentences.en: This modification involves adding a 31 mm length of 1.0 mm silver-plated wire, configured as a quarter-wavelength (λ/4) antenna.
sentences.zh: 此修改涉及添加 31 毫米长的 1.0 毫米镀银线，配置为四分之一波长 (λ/4) 天线。

sentences.en: The bottom section of the wire is bent into a horizontal loop (approximately 16 mm of the wire length, forming a loop with a diameter of about 8 mm), while the remaining 15 mm section is angled vertically upwards.
sentences.zh: 导线的底部部分弯曲成水平环（导线长度约 16 毫米，形成直径约 8 毫米的环），而其余 15 毫米部分垂直向上成角度。

blocks.html_en: I wrapped the circular loop around the shaft of a 5 mm drill and then widened the ends of the loop so that they touch the terminals of the SMD antenna. The SMD antenna effectively completes the wire loop—mechanically at a quarter of its circumference, but electrically as a λ/4 element in parallel with a λ/8 wire.

sentences.en: I wrapped the circular loop around the shaft of a 5 mm drill and then widened the ends of the loop so that they touch the terminals of the SMD antenna.
sentences.zh: 我将圆形环缠绕在 5 毫米钻头的轴上，然后加宽环的末端，以便它们接触 SMD 天线的端子。

sentences.en: The SMD antenna effectively completes the wire loop—mechanically at a quarter of its circumference, but electrically as a λ/4 element in parallel with a λ/8 wire.
sentences.zh: SMD 天线有效地完成了线环——机械上是在其圆周的四分之一处，但电气上是作为与 λ/8 线并联的 λ/4 元件。

blocks.html_en: Solder the new antenna directly to both ends of the original SMD antenna on the ESP32 module. Specifically, solder to the 50 Ohm antenna pin (the left end of the original antenna) and to the other “hot” end of the original antenna. This effectively bypasses the original PCB antenna. Ensuring two good solder joints at both ends of the PCB antenna is crucial. Pay close attention to the position of the wire that goes up from the loop. The old aerial has been left in place as it becomes electrically ineffective in this configuration.

sentences.en: Solder the new antenna directly to both ends of the original SMD antenna on the ESP32 module.
sentences.zh: 将新天线直接焊接到 ESP32 模块上原有 SMD 天线的两端。

sentences.en: Specifically, solder to the 50 Ohm antenna pin (the left end of the original antenna) and to the other “hot” end of the original antenna.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，焊接到 50 欧姆天线引脚（原始天线的左端）和原始天线的另一个“热”端。

sentences.en: This effectively bypasses the original PCB antenna.
sentences.zh: 这有效地绕过了原来的 PCB 天线。

sentences.en: Ensuring two good solder joints at both ends of the PCB antenna is crucial.
sentences.zh: 确保 PCB 天线两端的焊点良好至关重要。

sentences.en: Pay close attention to the position of the wire that goes up from the loop.
sentences.zh: 密切注意从环路上升的电线的位置。

sentences.en: The old aerial has been left in place as it becomes electrically ineffective in this configuration.
sentences.zh: 旧天线被保留在原处，因为它在这种配置中变得电气无效。

blocks.html_en: Results

sentences.en: Results
sentences.zh: 结果

blocks.html_en: The signal strength curves recorded with the WiFi Logger program consistently demonstrated a clear superiority of the modified module over the original. Under the testing conditions, where both modules were mounted side-by-side on a power bank and moved around various locations near an access point (AP), the modified antenna consistently provided higher signal levels.

sentences.en: The signal strength curves recorded with the WiFi Logger program consistently demonstrated a clear superiority of the modified module over the original.

sentences.en: Under the testing conditions, where both modules were mounted side-by-side on a power bank and moved around various locations near an access point (AP), the modified antenna consistently provided higher signal levels.
sentences.zh: 在测试条件下，两个模块并排安装在移动电源上，并在接入点 (AP) 附近的各个位置移动，修改后的天线始终提供更高的信号水平。

blocks.html_en: On average, the improvement in signal strength was at least approximately 6dB. In many cases, particularly at the edges of the WiFi signal range or in environments with more interference, the improvement even exceeded 10dB. This difference in signal strength had a significant impact on the stability of the connection. The modified module maintained a stable connection while the unmodified module was more prone to disconnections or performance degradation.

sentences.en: To illustrate the results:

blocks.html_en: • In close proximity to the Access Point: The improvement was often 6 dB to 8 dB, resulting in a more stable and less fluctuating connection.

blocks.html_en: The original SMD antenna CrossAir CA-C03 placed at the ESP32-C3 SuperMini module, due to its small size, high dielectrical ceramic material, and the compact antenna geometry, is inherently less efficient at radiating and receiving RF energy than an in-air-standing antenna wire . Just because it is designed as a very compact quarter-wave antenna, on the other hand this results in a limited bandwidth and a more omnidirectional radiation pattern.

blocks.html_en:
The <Datasheet> of the SMD antenna CA-C03 by Cross Air requires:
• PCB edge positioning,
• sufficient clearance around it,
• a 3.8 mm × 0.5 mm stripline,
• a 3 nH inductance “Shunt1”

blocks.html_en: The actual ESP32-C3 SuperMini‘s PCB design lacks several key features, most notably adequate free space around the antenna and an orthogonally radiating stripline, which also affects the antenna’s resonance frequency. These limitations result in misalignment, partially reflected RF energy and reduced RF efficiency.

sentences.en: These limitations result in misalignment, partially reflected RF energy and reduced RF efficiency.

blocks.html_en: An experimental, freer-standing mounting of the SMD antenna, more in line with the datasheet specifications, has already demonstrated an approximate 4 dB improvement in gain.

sentences.en: An experimental, freer-standing mounting of the SMD antenna, more in line with the datasheet specifications, has already demonstrated an approximate 4 dB improvement in gain.

blocks.html_en: However, this could not overcome the fundamental limitations of this very compact SMD antenna compared to the simple quarter-wave wire antenna described as a modification here.

blocks.html_en: The latter angled wire antenna benefits from its electrically non-shortened geometry and a more unobstructed and more effective omnidirectional radiation, achieving sure gains of 6–10 dB compared to the original SMD antenna.

sentences.en: The latter angled wire antenna benefits from its electrically non-shortened geometry and a more unobstructed and more effective omnidirectional radiation, achieving sure gains of 6–10 dB compared to the original SMD antenna.
sentences.zh: 后者的倾斜线天线受益于其电气上不缩短的几何形状以及更无障碍和更有效的全向辐射，与原始 SMD 天线相比，可实现 6-10 dB 的增益。

blocks.html_en: In contrast, the new, non-shortened and freestanding quarter-wave antenna can produce an undampened and more consistent field. This is likely due to the combination of now unshielded horizontal and vertical elements, which helps minimize null points in the omnidirectional radiation pattern and enhances signal coverage. The loop at the bottom of the antenna creates a horizontal radiation pattern without nulls, while the orthogonally angled element optimizes the vertically polarized component of the signal.

blocks.html_en:
All these factors in the unmodified module appear to result in a poor standing wave ratio (SWR) at its RF output. This means that a significant portion of the RF energy is reflected back from the antenna into the ESP32 and thus can’t be radiated. As an additional consequence, the final TX stage heats up, potentially reducing the actual RF output power and thereby again reducing the transmission range. Under unfavorable conditions, the ESP32 may still receive a strong enough Wi-Fi signal, but the access point might receive a weaker or even insufficient signal from the ESP32.
The result is a significantly reduced Wi-Fi operation range of the unmodified module.

sentences.zh: 未修改模块中的所有这些因素似乎都会导致其射频输出的驻波比 (SWR) 较差。

sentences.en: This means that a significant portion of the RF energy is reflected back from the antenna into the ESP32 and thus can’t be radiated.

sentences.en: As an additional consequence, the final TX stage heats up, potentially reducing the actual RF output power and thereby again reducing the transmission range.
sentences.zh: 另外一个后果是，最终 TX 级变热，可能会降低实际 RF 输出功率，从而再次降低传输范围。

content_html_zh:
增强 ESP32-C3 SuperMini WiFi：简单有效的天线模块

ESP32-C3 SuperMini 模块价格极其实惠，价格约为 2 欧元，并配备紧凑型 SMD 天线。 然而，由于其设计，这种微型天线极大地限制了可用的 WiFi 范围。 为了以最小的努力解决这个问题，我实施了一个简单的天线修改，极大地提高了性能。

天线修改

此修改涉及添加 31 毫米长的 1.0 毫米镀银线，配置为四分之一波长 (λ/4) 天线。 导线的底部部分弯曲成水平环（导线长度约 16 毫米，形成直径约 8 毫米的环），而其余 15 毫米部分垂直向上成角度。

我将圆形环缠绕在 5 毫米钻头的轴上，然后加宽环的末端，以便它们接触 SMD 天线的端子。 SMD 天线有效地完成了线环——机械上是在其圆周的四分之一处，但电气上是作为与 λ/8 线并联的 λ/4 元件。

将新天线直接焊接到 ESP32 模块上原有 SMD 天线的两端。 具体来说，焊接到 50 欧姆天线引脚（原始天线的左端）和原始天线的另一个“热”端。 这有效地绕过了原来的 PCB 天线。 确保 PCB 天线两端的焊点良好至关重要。 密切注意从环路上升的电线的位置。 旧天线被保留在原处，因为它在这种配置中变得电气无效。

编辑：与此同时，我的天线设计的一些修改已在博客文章和 YouTube 视频中发布。 然而，其中一些改造与天线线的总长度 31 毫米相矛盾，因此有人建议延长垂直部分，使整个天线成为 5/8 λ 辐射器。 如果您希望天线全向辐射并保持可接受的机械尺寸，那么这不是很明智。

使用 WiFi 记录器程序进行测试

为了评估此修改的有效性，我使用了为 ANNEX32 BASIC 编写的自定义 WiFi 记录器程序。 该程序比较两个 ESP32 模块的信号强度 (RSSI)：一个未修改，另一个使用新天线。

实时信号数据在平板电脑浏览器上实时显示。

两个模块并排安装在便携式移动电源上，以确保在接入点 (AP) 附近的不同位置移动时具有相同的测试条件。

结果

使用 WiFi Logger 程序记录的信号强度曲线一致证明了修改后的模块相对于原始模块具有明显的优势。 在测试条件下，两个模块并排安装在移动电源上，并在接入点 (AP) 附近的各个位置移动，修改后的天线始终提供更高的信号水平。

平均而言，信号强度至少提高了约 6dB。 在许多情况下，特别是在 WiFi 信号范围的边缘或干扰较多的环境中，改善甚至超过 10dB。 信号强度的差异对连接的稳定性有重大影响。 修改后的模块保持稳定的连接，而未修改的模块更容易断开连接或性能下降。

为了说明结果：

  • 靠近接入点：改善通常为 6 dB 至 8 dB，从而实现更稳定且波动更小的连接。
  • 在距接入点较远的地方：改善通常达到 10 dB 或更多，从而造成可用连接和不可用连接之间的差异。 修改后的模块可以接收和发送数据，而未修改的模块无法建立连接或数据传输速度极慢。
  • 在有障碍物（例如墙壁）的环境中：与难以保持信号的未修改模块相比，修改后的天线表现出更好的穿透力并提供更稳定的连接。

这些改进显着扩展了 WiFi 范围。 理论上，信号强度每增加 6 dB，范围就会增加一倍。 实际上，这意味着修改后的 ESP32-C3 SuperMini 模块能够在未修改的模块没有或只有非常不稳定的连接的区域建立可靠的 WiFi 连接。

观察结果

放置在 ESP32-C3 SuperMini 模块中的原始 SMD 天线 CrossAir CA-C03 由于其尺寸小、高介电陶瓷材料和紧凑的天线几何形状，在辐射和接收 RF 能量方面本质上比空中天线线的效率较低。 另一方面，正是因为它被设计为非常紧凑的四分之一波长天线，所以这导致了有限的带宽和更加全向的辐射方向图。

但特别需要指出的是，天线并未放置在制造商在数据表中明确推荐的 PCB 位置上。 相反，SMD 天线安装得太靠近接地层和其他组件。 这种定位屏蔽了射频能量，而不是允许有效辐射。

我尝试了用 0.8 毫米普通开关线制成的新天线，甚至从板上拆下了 SMD 天线。 但实际上，使用 1 毫米镀银线和未触及的 SMD 天线，其效果要好约 2dB。

*非常*紧凑的天线设计的注意事项

Cross Air 的 SMD 天线 CA-C03 的<数据表>要求：• PCB 边缘定位，• 周围有足够的间隙，• 3.8 mm × 0.5 mm 带状线，• 3 nH 电感“分流 1”

实际的 ESP32-C3 SuperMini 的 PCB 设计缺乏几个关键功能，最明显的是天线周围足够的自由空间和正交辐射带状线，这也会影响天线的谐振频率。 这些限制会导致失准、部分反射射频能量以及降低射频效率。

SMD 天线的实验性独立式安装更符合数据表规格，已经证明增益提高了大约 4 dB。

然而，与此处描述的简单四分之一波线天线相比，这无法克服这种非常紧凑的 SMD 天线的基本限制。

后者的倾斜线天线受益于其电气上不缩短的几何形状以及更无障碍和更有效的全向辐射，与原始 SMD 天线相比，可实现 6-10 dB 的增益。

相比之下，新型非缩短式独立式四分之一波长天线可以产生不受衰减且更一致的场。 这可能是由于现在未屏蔽的水平和垂直元件的组合，这有助于最大限度地减少全向辐射图案中的零点并增强信号覆盖范围。 天线底部的环路可形成无零点的水平辐射方向图，而正交元件则优化信号的垂直极化分量。

未修改模块中的所有这些因素似乎都会导致其射频输出的驻波比 (SWR) 较差。 这意味着很大一部分 RF 能量从天线反射回 ESP32，因此无法辐射。 另外一个后果是，最终 TX 级变热，可能会降低实际 RF 输出功率，从而再次降低传输范围。 在不利条件下，ESP32 仍可能接收到足够强的 Wi-Fi 信号，但接入点可能会从 ESP32 接收到较弱甚至不足的信号。 结果是未修改模块的 Wi-Fi 操作范围显着减小。

有趣的是，移除实际上已经过时的原始 PCB 天线并没有明显的效果，因此没有必要。 这表明新天线的低阻抗下部完全优于 PCB 天线，从而使新的、更突出的导线能够更有效地接管并辐射 RF 信号。 然而，值得注意的是，线材成角度端的正确放置和方向及其总长度和直径对于获得最佳性能至关重要。

结论

所提出的天线修改提供了一种引人注目且经济高效的方法，可显着增强 ESP32-C3 SuperMini 模块的 WiFi 性能。 通过将库存 PCB 天线与精心制作的四分之一波长线天线相结合，用户可以体验到信号强度、稳定性和范围的显着改进。 观察到的 6dB 至超过 10dB 的增益意味着更可靠的连接，特别是在信号较弱或有障碍物的环境中。 这一修改不仅扩展了 ESP32-C3 的可用范围，而且还释放了其在需要强大且一致的无线通信的应用中的潜力。 虽然修改需要基本的焊接技能，但由此产生的性能提升对于寻求最大限度地发挥这些廉价模块功能的爱好者、制造商和开发人员来说是值得的。
